attchmntText: Quadrant Future Tek Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Quadrant Future Tek Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of funds raised through its Initial Public Offer for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of IPO proceeds. Funds were raised on 10-01-2025, totaling 2900.00 million. The monitoring agency is CARE. The statement details allocations for related issue expenses, long-term working capital for the specialty cable division, capital expenditure for the electronic interlocking system, repayment of working capital term loans, and general corporate purposes. Specific utilization figures are reported for each object, with nil deviation noted for most categories except capital expenditure, where 16.5 million was utilized against an allocation of 243.80 million. The audit committee and auditors have raised no comments. The filing was signed by Company Secretary Puneet Khurana and the Chief Financial Officer on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Quadrant Future Tek Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Quadrant Future Tek Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 10, 2026. The company reported a loss of 76.58 million INR for the quarter and 167.91 million INR for the half year. Revenue from operations was 372.15 million INR for the quarter and 778.02 million INR for the half year. Basic earnings per share stood at negative 1.91 INR for the quarter and negative 4.19 INR for the half year. Statutory auditors Sanmarks & Associates issued a review report noting cash losses incurred during the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and the preceding quarter ended June 30, 2026. The auditor drew attention to management's assessment and proposed steps to address these losses. The company's shares are listed on the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.
